newsitem.title: POLAND: Handlowy gives Elektrobudowa buy rating.
newsitem.headline: Handlowy gives Elektrobudowa buy rating.

text.p: Investors should buy shares of Polish construction firm Elektrobudowa SA, which should benefit from a strong client base and increased domestic demand, the brokerage unit of Bank Handlowy SA said in a report.

"Taking into account the company's good development prospects, we recommend to investors with long-term horizons to buy shares of the company," the report dated December 6 and released on Monday, said.
On December 6 Elektrobudowa closed at 43 zlotys and closed at 50 zlotys on Monday.

Handlowy said good signs were growing investment in the Polish power industry and that Elektrobudowa had expanded its client base from electric power plants to the refining, petrochemical and steel industries.
Handlowy said negative signs were Elektrobudowa's fewer foreign subcontracts as a result of less foreign work by firms such as Elektrim, and that foreign competitors had entered the Polish market.
"This is a potential threat to Elektrobudowa, which is a small company in comparison with the world's giants in this sector," the report said.

It said Elektrobudowa would lift net profits to 13.5 million zlotys in 1996 and 16.8 million this year from 8.4 million in 1995. Sales would rise to 215 million zlotys in 1996 and 270 million this year from 169 million in 1995.
